description: Frontend (R10, PD20, PD24, PD25): role awareness (Role 'customer', AudienceGuard, sign-in routing, Session.init onHandleEvent), the accessible app/portal route group and components, services/portalApi.ts, the Stripe Payment Element pay page loaded from js.stripe.com, staff PortalAccessPanel and the Orders 'Awaiting confirmation' filter + Confirm/Decline, CSP Stripe origins (still Report-Only), the pinned @axe-core/playwright dev dependency and portal Playwright specs (run on staging per F5, not in CI), plus Jest tests UI-1..UI-5 and OID-4. Design §10, §6.4, F5, D6. Depends on the backend API shapes from FEAT-001..FEAT-005.
steps: 1. Setup: cd <wt>/runsheet && npm ci (worktree has no node_modules; keep >= 8 GB free disk). Add "@axe-core/playwright": "4.13.0" (exact) to devDependencies with `npm install --save-dev --save-exact @axe-core/playwright@4.13.0` and commit package.json + package-lock.json.

2. Role awareness: runsheet/src/config/modules.ts Role gains 'customer' and canSee/hasAnyRole visibility returns false for every module when roles include customer (incl. modules without requiredRoles). runsheet/src/config/supertokens.ts: Session.init({ onHandleEvent }) dispatching window CustomEvent 'runsheet:session-changed' for SESSION_CREATED, SIGN_OUT, ACCESS_TOKEN_PAYLOAD_UPDATED, UNAUTHORISED. New runsheet/src/components/AudienceGuard.tsx exactly per design §10.1 (resolve once per session, cached audience on pathname change, redirects for customer on /dashboard,/admin,/commerce,/compliance,/ops,/orders -> /portal and staff on /portal -> /dashboard, unknown/signed_out never redirect, null only while pending on staff/portal prefixes or during its own redirect), mounted once in runsheet/src/app/layout.tsx inside SuperTokensProvider. runsheet/src/app/signin/page.tsx routes customers to /portal after OK.

3. runsheet/src/services/portalApi.ts: typed functions for every design §3 route via fetchWithSession + apiErrorFromResponse like commerceApi.ts; blob downloads like exportApi.ts; Idempotency-Key header for payment create; Retry-After surfaced on 429; no WebSocket. runsheet/src/types/stripe-js.d.ts minimal declarations (Stripe(pk), elements({clientSecret}), create('payment'), mount, confirmPayment).

4. Portal route group runsheet/src/app/portal/: layout.tsx (client session gate -> /signin; non-customer -> /dashboard; PortalShell), page.tsx, orders/page.tsx, orders/new/page.tsx, invoices/page.tsx, invoices/[invoiceId]/page.tsx, invoices/[invoiceId]/pay/page.tsx, tanks/page.tsx, tanks/[tankId]/page.tsx, each segment with a layout.tsx exporting metadata.title. runsheet/src/components/portal/: PortalShell (skip link, header with supplier/customer names and Sign out, nav aria-label='Portal' with aria-current, main#main tabIndex -1; imports nothing from Sidebar/Header/AIChat/GlobalSearch/NotificationBell/ws hooks/dashboard shell-context), PortalNav, StatusText, LiveRegion, OrderRequestForm (labels, aria-describedby errors, role=alert summary with focus, date min/max local today..+60d, optional window via two time inputs, PD10 message in role=status, aria-disabled submit with early-return handler, client_event_id kept), InvoiceTable, PaymentForm (next/script js.stripe.com/v3 afterInteractive, amount field $1.00..remaining, 'Bank account' heading, sessionStorage key per invoice, confirmPayment redirect if_required, 3 s poll up to 60 s without include_client_secret, one include_client_secret=true call on reload, PD15 text when unavailable), TankCard (text level + <meter aria-label>, stale text, 'Forecast not available yet'), DeliveryHistoryTable. PD23 formatting with Intl; 320 px reflow; targets >= 24x24 px; existing Tailwind tokens.

5. Staff UI (PD24): runsheet/src/components/commerce/PortalAccessPanel.tsx on CustomerDetailPage.tsx only for hasAnyRole(roles, ['admin']), hidden on 404; invite shows link in a read-only field with Copy; Resend/Revoke with the existing Modal confirm. runsheet/src/components/ops/OrdersPage.tsx 'Awaiting confirmation' quick filter sending status=on_hold&hold_reason=awaiting_dispatcher_confirmation via runsheet/src/services/ordersApi.ts (new hold_reason param). runsheet/src/components/orders/OrderDetailView.tsx Confirm (release-hold {notes:'confirmed'}) and Decline (cancel {reason:'declined_by_dispatcher'}) for admin/dispatcher on that hold reason; 409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION reloads and shows 'This request changed. Reloaded the latest version.'

6. CSP: runsheet/src/config/securityHeaders.ts adds script-src https://js.stripe.com, frame-src https://js.stripe.com https://hooks.stripe.com https://*.stripe.com, connect-src https://api.stripe.com https://*.stripe.com; stays Report-Only (the base already has /api/csp-report from OI-10; keep it).

7. Jest tests: AudienceGuard.test.tsx (UI-1 all cases incl. mount-counter and single re-resolution), extend signin/page.test.tsx and config/modules.test.ts, portal/layout.test.tsx (UI-2 T-UI-SHELL: staff modules mocked to throw on import, global.WebSocket spy), components/portal/__tests__/OrderRequestForm.test.tsx (OID-4 shows_message_keeps_values_no_retry + UI-3), PaymentForm/TankCard/InvoiceTable tests (UI-3, PD15, stale, no forecast, 429 message), PortalAccessPanel.test.tsx and extended OrderDetailView test (UI-4), extended securityHeaders.test.ts (UI-5). Existing staff Jest suites pass unchanged.

8. Playwright (F5, not in CI): runsheet/e2e/portal/*.spec.ts with axe (zero serious/critical) on every portal page, keyboard-only sign-in -> new request -> invoice PDF download, and 320 px reflow (scrollWidth <= clientWidth); driven by PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL and QA portal credentials from env; skip cleanly when those env vars are absent. Ensure playwright.config.ts does not run them by default in local `npm test` (Jest) runs.
9. Final backend touch: regenerate docs/endpoint-registry.md if any route changed and confirm it is clean.
acceptance_criteria: `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm test -- --ci` and `npm run build` all pass in runsheet/
OID-4: a mocked 409 ORDER_INTAKE_DISABLED shows the PD10 text in role=status, keeps all inputs, sets aria-disabled and fetch is called exactly once
UI-2: the portal layout imports and renders no staff shell module and constructs no WebSocket
UI-1: customers are redirected from staff prefixes to /portal and staff from /portal to /dashboard; staff navigation within /dashboard never remounts the child
securityHeaders.test.ts asserts the Stripe origins and that the policy is still Report-Only
package.json pins @axe-core/playwright at exactly 4.13.0 and no runtime dependency is added

npx playwright test e2e/portal --list (specs compile and are discovered; they skip without PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL)
